terra.problem: Saying the man tried the door adds an attempt to escape that the text does not describe.
The chains are not described as being on one side of him. He says they weigh him down.
Saying he keeps crying out suggests continued action beyond what the verse states.
Saying he picked the animals because they surprise people supplies a reason the text does not give, even though it is marked as a guess.
The claim that a sleeping animal would not worry anybody is not true, particularly in a picture involving a bear and a lion.
Saying he lost both at once adds a timing detail the verse does not give.
